draft_backbone_oracle.note: Real checkpoint weights, deterministic synthetic target features; reference disables BF16 reduced precision accumulation.

earlier_failure: An initial prompt asking for implementation plus tests produced a correct merge_intervals function but one erroneous self-generated test for reversed interval endpoints. That output was not counted as passing. The final suite specifies start <= end and uses independent tests.
method: Single process, same loaded target/draft weights and device placement, no history cache for timing. The reported steady-state rates use the second paired greedy cycle, after a full target warmup and a full first cycle of both modes. All cold and first-cycle results are retained. The current case generator explicitly warms both modes. Decode rate excludes the first token. Random samples have independent RNG streams. CPU microbenchmarks repeat one layer, excluding setup and packing; they are not end-to-end model speed.
